C0a.name: C0a CONTROL: the engine's no-trigger halos match NFW (declared c-M) within 25% at 0.3, 0.5 and 1.0 r200 for every host

C0b.name: C0b CONTROL: the 1e12 fossil's max dark pull and converted fraction agree within 15% between 600 and 1000 shells

H2a.name: H2a the dark-only fossil's maximum dark pull lies below the no-trigger run's and below sqrt(1 - f_b) a0 wherever the trigger fires, both footings

H2b.name: H2b the escaped share is >= 0.9 for hosts <= 1e11 and <= 0.1 for hosts >= 1e13, both footings

H2c.name: H2c the converted dark mass is <= 15% of the host's own dark mass for every host <= 1e13, both footings

H2d.name: H2d (reported) the realized cap of the dark collapse, per host

H2e.name: H2e (reported) with the galaxy condensing, the phase-mixed survivors contract above the collapse-time cap (the coherence clause forbids converting them): the fossil's baryon-dominated inner halo inherits the contraction

H2f.name: H2f (reported) clusters keep their dark mass: the retention inside R500 per footing

V.name: V (reported) the v_k window moves the escaped share, not the cap

ledger.text: the dark collapse converts where coherent crossing streams exceed P_c; the survivors form a hollowed, capped core
galaxies lose the converted mass (v_k > v_esc), groups and clusters keep it bound and hotter
the converted budget is a few percent of a galaxy's dark mass
phase-mixed survivors contract when the galaxy condenses (the coherence clause cannot convert them): the inner dark pull of baryon-dominated galaxies is the contracted fossil, not the collapse cap
the engine's choices: FP16's initial profile and MAH form, lambda_j 0.15-0.35, f_R = 0.02, f_gal = 2 M*/(f_b M_h), 48-neighbour stress, the coherence window, softening 0.2 kpc
